# Cosmos

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 12 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Visual-bookmarking discovery surfaces: cosmosOracle display (72-88px, 700, -3% tracking) on white with a near-black lab(3.6%) ink, a full declared --light-*/--dark-* semantic layer (dark declared, never painted publicly), rounded-full pills on every control (48px CTAs, 56px search/auth, 40px tabs, an 82px hero search), paper-gray element tiles with a 3px --radius-element, 12%/10% ink color-mix hairlines, a masonry explore feed and the disabled->enabled ink inversion on the auth Next.

Captured 2026-11-12, signed out (every captured surface is public; the saved-element feed, boards, clusters and settings sit behind the /login card and were never reached; the login fields were focused and sample-filled then cleared, never submitted; no account created).. Themes: light, dark.

Cosmos's public signed-out surface — the home page, the explore/search/brand/profile discovery surfaces, sequence, shop, careers, the sign-up start and the public login card — captured 2026-11-12 in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900, plus the home and explore pages at 390 x 844. The product behind the login card was never reached.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.
